title: TBD Map Height Labels
description: Elevation markers for a terrain: named peaks and hills merged from `locations.json`, plus anonymous DEM-prominence peaks. Unnamed peaks are filtered to prominence ≥ PEAK_MIN_VALUE_M. Coordinates are x east, y north, in world metres — the same frame as the terrain manifest's `worldBounds`.

y.description: North meters (Reforger world Z → export Y).

kind.description: Height-marker taxonomy (mirrors Rust HeightLabelKind). Named hills are exported as 'peak'.

name.description: Optional toponym for a named peak or hill. Absent on anonymous DEM peaks. Rendered as '{name} · {value_m} m'.
